headline: EPS nearly doubles both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Hyosung Heavy Industries reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩18,534, up 97.8% q/q from ₩9,370 and up 86.5% y/y from ₩9,936.
summary_long: EPS of ₩18,534 rose 97.8% sequentially from ₩9,370 and 86.5% year-over-year from ₩9,936. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
